comment: Plugins in their own repositories that this release offers (INSTALL_PLUGIN, HelixScreen Settings > Plugins) and is tested with (tools/test_plugin_repos.sh). components: Moonraker components that must load (test only). Community plugins (not Kiln's own repositories): commit (pinned, 40 hex) and author required (tools/test_plugin_catalog.py, docs/plugins.md).

plugins.name: notify
plugins.title: Notifications
plugins.description: Print notifications with a camera photo: Telegram, Discord, ntfy, e-mail and 100+ more (set up with NOTIFY_SETUP)

plugins.name: timelapse
plugins.title: Timelapse
plugins.description: Timelapse videos of your prints from the camera (Fluidd's Timelapse tab)

plugins.name: spoolman
plugins.title: Spoolman
plugins.description: A Spoolman spool per IFS slot: the loaded slot's spool is the active one (needs a Spoolman server: Spool inventory below, or Spoolman on another computer)

plugins.name: microspool
plugins.title: Spool inventory
plugins.description: Spools on the printer itself: microspool, a small Spoolman-compatible server with a web page on port 7912 (with the IFS, also install Spoolman)

plugins.name: macro-pack
plugins.title: Macro pack
plugins.description: Everyday printer macros for Fluidd and Mainsail (light, preheat, park, purge, IFS, calibration, camera snapshots), grouped and coloured in their macro panels

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.title: Tailscale (remote access)
plugins.description: Fluidd and Moonraker from anywhere through your own Tailscale tailnet, no ports opened on your router (needs Extended memory on a 512 MiB printer)

plugins.name: happy-hare
plugins.title: Happy Hare
plugins.description: Happy Hare MMU software in place of Kiln's IFS driver: tool changes parked at the toolhead, the IFS synced with the extruder, clog detection from the IFS stall sensors (needs the IFS on Klipper firmware)
plugins.author: moggieuk (Happy Hare), Hunter Laux (AD5X IFS)

plugins.name: afc
plugins.title: AFC (Armored Turtle)
plugins.description: AFC-Klipper-Add-On with the AD5X IFS as an AFC unit: Kiln does the loads, unloads and swaps (needs the AD5X IFS, or an AFC unit through AFC_FF)
plugins.author: DIEHARDave

plugins.name: ff_nfc
plugins.title: NFC filament tags
plugins.description: Scan a spool's NFC/RFID tag, pick the IFS slot, and its material, colour and Spoolman spool are set (needs a USB NFC reader: PN532 or ACR122U)
plugins.author: DIEHARDave

plugins.name: diehard-pushraker
plugins.title: pushraker notifications
plugins.description: Push notifications (ntfy, Pushover, Telegram, Discord, e-mail ... with snapshots), Discord status cards and update notices; settings page on port 82. Replaces the notify plugin
plugins.author: DIEHARDave (pushraker by noon92)
